messages:
Elaine: quick sync — did a short a11y sweep on the Models table keyboard nav the morning build. noticed weird interaction between our roving tabindex implementation and the live region we use for filter counts. Maya: thanks for flagging. can you repro reliably? which screen reader? Elaine: yes, repro on mac + VO and Windows + NVDA. steps: open /models, focus table, use arrow keys to move rows, then apply a filter — VO announces the new count AND re-announces the currently focused row text. it ends up verbose and confusing. Samir: i can repro on Linux + NVDA too. seems like when the DOM updates we re-render the whole row and the live region picks up changes from child nodes. Jonas: can you paste a tiny snippet of the row render? curious about role/aria attributes. Elaine: here's the gist: ``` Model name Ready
Showing 12 models
``` When filter changes we update #live-status and also re-render table rows which seems to retrigger SR announcements. Maya: ok that pattern can cause double announces. live region should be outside of elements that get re-rendered and we should avoid updating an element that is a parent of the focused node. Samir: also noticed we set tabindex="-1" on all rows and then set tabindex=0 on the focused row — that's expected for roving. but our focus move code does `element.focus()` right after DOM replace which might create a timing issue where SR hears both the re-rendered content and the live region update. Clara: what's the proposed fix? small change or bigger refactor? Maya: proposed fixes: • ensure the live region is mounted outside the table subtree that gets re-rendered (e.g., top-level status container). • batch updates so the live region update happens after focus is restored (use requestAnimationFrame or microtask). • minimize DOM churn on rows: keep stable ids and avoid replacing nodes; update textContent instead. • for aria-describedby, make sure IDs referenced exist and don't change on every render. Samir: i like keeping live region outside and changing update order. quick patch: move #live-status to page header and defer its update until after focus callback. Jonas: another small improvement — instead of `aria-live="polite"` on a general container, use a live region only for counts and non-focused notifications. for per-row transient state prefer `aria-atomic="false"` on the region so it doesn't re-announce whole subtree. Elaine: tested Samir's local patch: moved live region to header + deferred update via setTimeout 50ms. VO behavior improved — it announced "Showing 11 models" only, no re-announcement of row text. NVDA also much better. Maya: nice! two accessibility nit follow-ups: 1) ensure keyboard roving still meets focus-visible expectations (show outline only on keyboard focus, not mouse). 2) confirm aria-describedby references the correct status element (we had mismatch where id changed to status-undefined on fast updates). Clara: prioritize this for the next minor release? sounds like a regression for keyboard users. Samir: i'll open a PR with the minimal changes: move live region node, add small debounce for updates, and ensure stable ids for row status. assigning to @Samir. Jonas: can you add a unit test that simulates a filter update and assert live region text update happens after focus restore? helps catch regressions. Samir: yep will add test + a tiny e2e scenario in the accessibility folder. Maya: also please add a short note in the changelog: "a11y: reduce duplicate SR announcements during filtering — live region and roving focus timing fixes". Elaine: filing the quick reproduction steps in the ticket so PMs can see impact. Clara: thanks team — @a11y-bot can you add this thread to the a11y board? a11y-bot: added card "Keyboard roving + live region double announce" to backlog with label `regression` and priority `high`. Elaine: perfect. i'll validate the PR on mac+vo once it's up and post results here. Maya: appreciate it — tiny user-facing improvement but high value. :thumbsup:
